# Xania Monet (Wikipedia)

## Key findings
- **Xania Monet** is "an artificial intelligence music project generated by Telisha 'Nikki' Jones, starting in 2025."
- Infobox caption: **"A 2025 AI image of Monet"** — the persona's visual is an AI-generated image.
- "How Was I Supposed to Know?" was the **first AI song to enter a Billboard radio airplay chart** (Adult R&B Airplay No. 30; Hot R&B Songs No. 20). "Let Go, Let God" peaked No. 3 Hot Gospel Songs.
- Jones, from Mississippi, **writes the lyrics herself** and uses **Suno** to generate the music.
- **"A music video for 'How Was I Supposed to Know?' uses live-action footage."** (ref [5] = the official YouTube MV)
- Signed to **Hallwood Media for $3 million** following a bidding war.
- **Kehlani** criticized the deal, saying Jones was "doing none of the work."

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Wikipedia with primary references (CBS, Billboard, YouTube).
- Establishes: Xania Monet = AI R&B project by Telisha Jones (Black woman, Mississippi); visual persona is a **2025 AI image**; MV uses **live-action footage** (not AI-generated video); $3M Hallwood deal; Kehlani criticism.
